workOrdersReserved.description:
Represents number of {@link WorkOrder}s which have a given {@link InventorySeries#partNumber} part allocated/reserved for it's execution.
Only considers {@link WorkOrder}s scheduled in the future.

workOrdersImpacted.description:
Represents number of {@link WorkOrder}s which have a given {@link InventorySeries#partNumber} required for it's execution, but was not allocated to it.
Only considers {@link WorkOrder}s scheduled in the future.

title: Type housing all statistics for a given {@link InventorySeries#partNumber} part and corresponding {@link WorkOrder}s.
name: WorkOrderStats
